$comment: Canonical lifecycle for the standalone agent (the abstract state machine, as data). The lifecycle skill reads this to drive the task; the command-center can read the same file to render the board. The eval harness may override it per strategy via $AI_DEV_PIPELINE. 'runner: main' = the main session does the phase; 'subagent:<name>' = delegate to that subagent (which pins its own model in its frontmatter). 'gate' names the hard check that must hold before leaving the phase ('tests', 'rubric' and 'ui-scenarios' are all enforced deterministically by the Stop-hook checker — rubric/ui via verdict markers the subagents write; see HARNESS.md).

phases.label: Analysis
phases.description: Explores the codebase and gathers context to write a spec.

phases.label: Spec
phases.description: Writes the spec, rubric, and acceptance criteria for human approval.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.description: Implements the approved spec with tests (mandatory hard gate).

phases.label: Review
phases.description: Code-reviewer subagent grades the rubric — any FAIL blocks shipping.

phases.label: UI verification
phases.description: Drives the app in a real browser to verify the UI.

phases.label: Documentation
phases.description: Writes/updates project docs and finalises the manual test guide.
